{{Top|canon=Dathomiri clan|notoc=1}}
'''Coven''' was the name given to a group or assembly of [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one particular coven of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;wielding [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] was led by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]].
